newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page- April 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page- April 14.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
* Pope John Paul II celebrated Mass for a crowd of around 35,000 in Sarajevo and called for forgiveness.
* The pace and precise scope of deregulation of the U.S. electric utility industry is generating debate in Congress and across the country.
* Eldrick Tiger Woods, age 21, won the Masters professional golf tournament with a record 12 strokes.
* Despite Friday's sharp decline in the stock market, small investors appear to be holding steady.
* There are almost as many female legislators as male legislators in the Washington State Senate.
* Trinity College is leading a movement to renew the community of Hartford where it is located.

* New York City school officials say their goal is to hold class size in kindergarten through third grade to an average of 25 children but a New York Times survey of city services shows classes are larger than officials acknowledge.
